title: 六周飙升近5000%：印尼权益资产被指人为设计，MSCI降级会否落地？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Imagine a stock surging nearly 5,000 per cent in just six weeks.
segments.zh: 想象一下，一只权益资产在短短六周内飙升近5000%。

segments.en: That creates an aura of a lot of investor interests.
segments.zh: 这营造出一种吸引众多市场参与者兴趣的氛围。

segments.en: But now imagine, it's all engineered.
segments.zh: 但现在想象一下，这一切都是人为设计的。

segments.en: Well, that's exactly what's happening in Indonesia.
segments.zh: 而这正是印度尼西亚正在发生的事情。

segments.en: And now? Indonesia is facing a potential ejection from global stock indexes.
segments.zh: 而现在？印尼面临被全球权益资产指数剔除的潜在风险。

segments.en: Our reporting shows how some Indonesian stocks were manipulated to attract global investors.
segments.zh: 我们的报道显示，一些印尼权益资产被操纵以吸引全球市场参与者。

segments.en: This has become so massive that it put questions on the credibility of Indonesia as a whole.
segments.zh: 此事规模巨大，引发了对印尼整体信誉的质疑。

segments.en: The country is Southeast Asia's largest economy and long seen as an investor darling.
segments.zh: 该国是东南亚最大经济体，长期被视为市场参与者的宠儿。

segments.en: Now, it's facing a crisis of confidence.
segments.zh: 如今，它正面临信心考验。

segments.en: Indonesia's stock market had a really strong 2025 and it actually reached a record in January this year.
segments.zh: 印尼市场在2025年表现非常强劲，今年1月更是创下历史新高。

segments.en: But ever since then, it's been on a bit of a downward trajectory.
segments.zh: 但自那以后，市场便步入下行通道。

segments.en: What escalated that sell-off was a warning.
segments.zh: 而一则警告加剧了这轮抛售。

segments.en: It came from MSCI, a major index provider that helps guide global investment.
segments.zh: 警告来自MSCI——一家为全球配置提供指引的主要指数供应商。

segments.en: MSCI came out in January with a statement saying that they are considering to the younger Indonesia into frontier market status from emerging market.
segments.zh: MSCI在1月发表声明称，正考虑将印尼从新兴市场降级为前沿市场。

segments.en: By October, it escalated the threat.
segments.zh: 到10月，这一威胁进一步升级。

segments.en: Warning, it could demote Indonesia even further.
segments.zh: 警告称，可能进一步下调印尼的评级。
